verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's official CLI (clickhousectl) can set up ClickHouse Cloud and create cloud-managed clusters, and the Cloud offering advertises starting instantly without sizing the cluster, with autoscaling that scales down to zero. However, there is no evidence of provisioning speed ("in seconds"), of the connection endpoint or credentials returned on creation, or of a documented API path for provisioning. Missing for 10: evidence that provisioning completes in seconds, documented ready-to-connect output (endpoint and credentials) on creation, documented API-based provisioning beyond an OpenAPI file probe, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a ready-to-connect database in seconds through the CLI or API without capacity planning

citations.quote: Set up ClickHouse Cloud and create cloud-managed ClickHouse clusters
Start building instantly without having to size and scale your cluster.
We automatically scale up and down compute resources based on your workload
We automatically scale unused resources down to zero so that you don't pay for idle services
